create or replace package body fiscal_calendar as
  function year_of(p_date in date) return number is
  begin
    return extract(year from p_date) + case when extract(month from p_date) >= 7 then 1 else 0 end;
  end year_of;

  function quarter_of(p_date in date) return number is
  begin
    -- Fiscal year starts July (Month 7).
    -- Q1: Jul, Aug, Sep (Months 7, 8, 9)
    -- Q2: Oct, Nov, Dec (Months 10, 11, 12)
    -- Q3: Jan, Feb, Mar (Months 1, 2, 3)
    -- Q4: Apr, May, Jun (Months 4, 5, 6)
    
    -- Standard calendar month: 1=Jan, 12=Dec
    -- Fiscal month mapping: 7=Jul, 8=Aug, 9=Sep, 10=Oct, 11=Nov, 12=Dec, 1=Jan, 2=Feb, 3=Mar, 4=Apr, 5=May, 6=Jun
    
    -- We map the calendar month (M) to a fiscal month (FM) where FM=1 is July.
    -- If M >= 7, FM = M - 6. (7->1, 8->2, 9->3, 10->4, 11->5, 12->6)
    -- If M < 7, FM = M + 6. (1->7, 2->8, 3->9, 4->10, 5->11, 6->12)
    
    -- The quarter is determined by floor((FM - 1) / 3) + 1.
    
    -- Let's use the original logic structure but adjust for the fiscal start month (July=7).
    -- If we treat July as month 1 of the fiscal year:
    
    -- Month 7 (Jul) -> Fiscal Month 1 -> Q1
    -- Month 9 (Sep) -> Fiscal Month 3 -> Q1
    -- Month 10 (Oct) -> Fiscal Month 4 -> Q2
    -- Month 12 (Dec) -> Fiscal Month 6 -> Q2
    -- Month 1 (Jan) -> Fiscal Month 7 -> Q3
    -- Month 3 (Mar) -> Fiscal Month 9 -> Q3
    -- Month 4 (Apr) -> Fiscal Month 10 -> Q4
    -- Month 6 (Jun) -> Fiscal Month 12 -> Q4
    
    -- Calculate the fiscal month number (1 to 12)
    DECLARE
        v_month_num NUMBER := extract(month from p_date);
        v_fiscal_month NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        IF v_month_num >= 7 THEN
            -- July (7) maps to 1, August (8) maps to 2, ..., December (12) maps to 6
            v_fiscal_month := v_month_num - 6;
        ELSE
            -- January (1) maps to 7, ..., June (6) maps to 12
            v_fiscal_month := v_month_num + 6;
        END IF;
        
        -- Calculate quarter: (Fiscal Month - 1) / 3 + 1
        RETURN TRUNC((v_fiscal_month - 1) / 3) + 1;
    END;
  end quarter_of;
end fiscal_calendar;
